evidence.reason: Web Audio retirement (instruments-web-audio-retirement 6ef40d59, 409d5638, ec989bf0, 1fa317b8, 4ca8adbb; hand record, no --bless; a direct audit like instruments-single-source-removal, stacked on instruments-browser-live-notes-audit). The browser plays only through the portable session: the legacy Web Audio live playback, the clip scheduler, the synth, sampler, Drum Rack and granular voices, their reference cores and the granular worklet are deleted. Whole-file deletions are not admissible through --allow-removal, so the engine gates leave their `files` maps as whole-object changes (diffJson records a removed key as old -> null, which setAt cannot apply). Counts measured with bun --conditions=browser test at 4ca8adbb against d5b16920 (whole packages/audio-engine/src: 920 -> 814 tests, 90 -> 82 files, nine test files deleted, audio-scheduling.test.ts 14 -> 11, the only other difference the new sampled-instrument-buffer-cache.test.ts with 5 pass, which the engine judge does not pin; the portable-wasm-host and lofi-worklet timing tests are flaky under load and differ in fail count only between runs). Direct audit of every removed test: (1) granular-core.test.ts (3): 'granular core > windows are finite, bounded, and have useful energy'; 'granular core > seed and density produce deterministic bounded schedules'; 'granular core > PRNG decisions cover deterministic reverse and stereo choices'. Why: granular-core.ts (window and schedule generation) is deleted in 409d5638; granular is rendered by the WASM core and checked by live-notes.browser.test.ts. (2) sampler-core.test.ts (11): 'sampler core > selects velocity ranges and advances round robin deterministically'; 'sampler core > bounds loop crossfade and envelope times'; 'sampler core > normalizes versioned persisted state and invalid loop bounds'; 'sampler core > evicts decoded buffers deterministically by least recent use'; 'sampler core > builds deterministic bounded equal-power crossfade segments'; 'sampler core > advances the first crossfade in playback time at every playback rate'; 'sampler core > keeps forward-loop sources alive through the note envelope'; 'sampler core > does not evict pinned decoded buffers'; 'sampler core > reports pinned over-budget state and evicts after the final unpin'; 'sampler core > reports evicted values so runtime holders can release decoded buffers'; 'sampler core > retains a replaced pinned value until its pin is released'. Why: sampler-core.ts is deleted in 409d5638. Five of its tests moved with the sampled buffer cache to packages/audio-engine/src/sampled-instrument-buffer-cache.test.ts under the same leaf names ('evicts decoded buffers deterministically by least recent use', 'does not evict pinned decoded buffers', 'reports pinned over-budget state and evicts after the final unpin', 'reports evicted values so holders can release decoded buffers', 'retains a replaced pinned value until its pin is released'; 5 pass, a new unpinned file); the other six exercised the Web Audio sampler reference core (velocity ranges, loop crossfade, persisted state, crossfade segments, forward loops), and the sampler now sounds only through the WASM core (live-notes.browser.test.ts, sampled-instrument-region.test.ts 4, unchanged).
